Triage notes: quick summary of what I've seen so far from the traces Samira sent.

Observations (first-pass):
- Spike in application-layer 502/504s originating from the realtime worker pool handling SSE chunk flushes.
- Traces show repeated back-and-forth at tokenization boundary: a subset of requests hit a slower quantized path that increases per-token cpu by ~3–4x causing backlog and intermittent write timeouts to the chunked response buffer.
- Correlated with a spike in connection churn on the west-us/oregon edge nodes.

Temporary mitigations I can apply within ~20 minutes:
1) Route Veridian traffic to a warmed dedicated pool (drops noisy neighbor risk).
2) Short-circuit quantized execution path for streams matching their model/profile (falls back to float path, slightly higher cost but stable latency).
3) Increase SSE socket write timeout and add additional keepalive pings to prevent client-side reconnection storms while we fix the root cause.

Request for Veridian: please enable --debug-client-retries and preserve one affected connection id for me to correlate.

Attached a short trace extract that points to the flush stall (initial_trace_snippet.txt). I'll push a mitigation playbook to the shared drive and execute step 1 immediately if we get the green light.

Marissa

Redwood Inference

- Disabled the experimental quantized streaming path for Veridian streams; traffic is now on the float path to reduce per-token CPU variance.
- Increased SSE write timeouts and added extra keepalive pings to minimize reconnection storms.

Next steps (0–24h):
1) Hotfix release to improve chunk flush resilience (owner: Marissa) — ETA 6 hours, will be staged to 10% then ramp.
2) Customer-side telemetry capture and correlation (owner: Rishi) — we will provide a script for a single pinned client to capture connection and retry logs.
3) Postmortem and SLA impact assessment (owner: Stephanie) — to be shared within 48 hours; will include compensation recommendation.

Acceptance tests we will run with Veridian:
- 30-minute steady-state stream at production load with no dropped chunks
- End-to-end tail-latency < 200ms for >95% of token emits
- No reconnection loop behavior for pinned connection id
